page_title: HOF 3-1 WOL | Hoffenheim v Wolfsburg 02/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' The match has just finished.
90+9' Goal, no wait. Felix Zwayer blows his whistle for handball and Jonas Wind (Wolfsburg) can't celebrate. Disallowed goal.
90+4' It's time for a substitution. Diadie Samassekou (Hoffenheim) comes on in place of Andrej Kramaric.
90+4' Kevin Paredes (Wolfsburg) makes a yard for himself inside the box after an accurate pass and takes a shot that goes just wide of the right post.
90' The fourth official shows 7 min. of added time.
90' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Mergim Berisha (Hoffenheim) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
86' Ridle Baku (Wolfsburg) has a sight of goal and shoots from long range but his ambitious effort flies just over the bar.
83' Niko Kovac has decided to make a change. Jakub Kaminski (Wolfsburg) replaces Vaclav Cerny.

83' A nice pass finds Ridle Baku (Wolfsburg) in space. He sets himself up and hammers in a fantastic shot from distance that looks bound for the top of the net, but Oliver Baumann pulls off a breathtaking save to deny him.
83' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
78' Substitution. Yannick Gerhardt (Wolfsburg) in, Mattias Svanberg out.
78' Referee Felix Zwayer points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. Robert Skov (Hoffenheim) goes wild in celebration.
77' Wait! Referee Felix Zwayer has indicated he is going to review the Hoffenheim goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was a handball in the build-up.
75' A yellow card for bad language! Mattias Svanberg (Wolfsburg) couldn’t remain silent and the result is obvious.

74' 3 - 1 It's in! Andrej Kramaric spots his teammate in a good position on the edge of the box and provides him with a nice pass. Robert Skov (Hoffenheim) doesn't think twice and curls a first-time shot into the top right corner. The score is now 3:1.
72' It’s hot out there so the ref signals there will be a cooling break for the players to take on some fluids.
68' Substitution. Joakim Maehle makes way for Ridle Baku (Wolfsburg).
68' Substitution. Amin Sarr (Wolfsburg) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Lovro Majer walks off.
68' Here is a change. Tiago Tomas is going off and Niko Kovac gives the last tactical orders to Kevin Paredes (Wolfsburg).
68' Substitution. Maximilian Beier leaves the pitch and is replaced by Mergim Berisha (Hoffenheim).
67' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim).
67' Ihlas Bebou (Hoffenheim) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Hoffenheim.
64' The Wolfsburg players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
60' 2 - 1 What a hit! Maximilian Beier (Hoffenheim) shows good composure inside the box to fire a first-time shot into the bottom right corner. 2:1.
59' Marius Bulter comes off the pitch to be replaced by Robert Skov (Hoffenheim).
57' Vaclav Cerny (Wolfsburg) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and immediately unleashes a shot which is wide of the mark.
55' Florian Grillitsch (Hoffenheim) gathers a cross inside the box and strikes the ball. He wastes a great scoring opportunity as his shot only hits the right-hand post.

53' Vaclav Cerny (Wolfsburg) tries his luck with a long-range effort after receiving a precise pass. It goes to the roof of the net, but Oliver Baumann has a clear view of it and makes a comfortable save.
50' Neat passing move from Wolfsburg in order to create new attacking opportunities.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+5' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+4' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Ihlas Bebou (Hoffenheim).

45+2' 1 - 1 It's a goal! Marius Bulter plays a lovely pass into the box and finds John Anthony Brooks (Hoffenheim). He tries his luck from close range and coolly strikes the ball into the back of the net. 1:1.
45' We will have 4 min. of added time.
45' Wout Weghorst (Hoffenheim) tries to bend in the free kick from the edge of the box, but the defensive wall makes an easy block.
43' Hoffenheim get the opportunity to endanger the opposition's goal with a free kick from the edge of the box.
43' Joakim Maehle (Wolfsburg) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
36' 0 - 1 Tiago Tomas (Wolfsburg) displays great tekkers inside the box leading to a fantastic goal, leaving the goalkeeper stranded.
32' The ball is cleared after Vaclav Cerny (Wolfsburg) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
31' Maximilian Beier (Hoffenheim) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
31' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
29' The corner kick is deflected to Florian Grillitsch (Hoffenheim), who unleashes a shot from long range. He doesn't hit the ball perfectly, however, and it goes wide of the goal.
29' Marius Bulter (Hoffenheim) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
27' It’s time for the cooling break for the players to take on some fluids. It’s hot out there!
26' Mattias Svanberg (Wolfsburg) elects to shoot from the edge of the box instead of sending the free kick into the box, but the defensive wall manages to block the shot. Wasted opportunity!
25' Ihlas Bebou (Hoffenheim) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
25' Ihlas Bebou (Hoffenheim) is penalised for holding. Felix Zwayer signals a set piece.
18' Great teamplay by Wolfsburg as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
15' Jonas Wind (Wolfsburg) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and immediately unleashes a shot which is wide of the mark.
14' Lovro Majer (Wolfsburg) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
14' Ihlas Bebou (Hoffenheim) is penalised after knocking an opponent down. Wolfsburg have a free kick.
10' Wout Weghorst (Hoffenheim) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Felix Zwayer had an easy-decision to make.
7' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Wolfsburg.

7' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) unleashes a sweet first-timer from the edge of the box which is headed for the underside of the crossbar. The goalkeeper stops the shot with a quick save. Wolfsburg get a corner.
2' Mattias Svanberg (Wolfsburg) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly towards the roof of the net, but Oliver Baumann is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
1' Flag up against Ihlas Bebou (Hoffenheim). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
1' The match has just started.
Hoffenheim will kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Felix Zwayer.
